text.headline: STARTING IN CYPRUS? ENTITY CHOICE MATTERS.
text.body: The Cyprus Registrar lists different registration costs and liability structures for a company, partnership, business name and an overseas company's place of business. Cost is only one part of the choice, so legal and tax advice may still be needed.
text.question: Keep this checklist before comparing options.

claims.text: The Cyprus Registrar lists registration costs of €165 for a company with share capital (€235 without), €120 for a partnership, €80 for a business name and €380 for a place of business of an overseas company.

sources.title: Cyprus Registrar: Choosing the right type of Business Entity
sources.reviewNote: Official comparison table: company €165 with share capital or €235 without; partnership €120; business name €80; overseas-company place of business €380. The page also distinguishes liability. Present as official filing information, not personalised legal advice.
